unmet.note: At least one CS course used as a technical elective must come from this list. CS 425 only counts for the 4 hour section.

At least 6 additional technical electives totalling at least 18 credit hours, chosen from CS 397 and CS 400-level courses, not including CS 400, CS 401, CS 402, CS 403 or CS 491. CS 500-level courses only with special permission from the CS Academic Office. CS 397 and CS 499 count with a cumulative maximum of 6 credits as technical electives. One "CS-like" course in another department may count as a CS 400-level course with CS Academic Office permission; non-CS technical electives are not considered in focus areas. Allowed courses are generated from catalog data by rule R4.

requirements.note: CS 210 (2 or 3 hours) or CS 211. If CS 211 is chosen it also satisfies the campus Advanced Composition requirement.
